documents.title: Aurora
documents.text: The northern lights occur when charged particles from the Sun interact with gases in Earth's upper atmosphere.

documents.title: Baking
documents.text: A sourdough starter is a mixture of flour and water that cultures wild yeast and bacteria. Feed it regularly to bake bread.
Mars appears red because iron minerals in its soil oxidize. The planet has a thin atmosphere and two small moons.

documents.title: Electric cars
documents.text: Battery electric vehicles store energy in rechargeable batteries and use electric motors instead of burning petrol.
